title: Swap the Names Before You Paste Into AI
description: We swapped a customer's details for placeholders before asking our AI for a reply. The swap worked. The reply put her phone number in the wrong place.
ogDescription: No real detail reached our AI. But the reply said "call us at [Phone]", and [Phone] was the customer's own number.
alt: AI reply that says Please call us at [Phone], where [Phone] stands for the customer's own number
ctaLine: Swap out, read, then swap back.
author: Nick
